title: Turn the TV on, pause it or turn it off
summary: Open the screen on the TV and control what it shows: appointments, pause or the promo.

steps.title: Menu → TV Display
steps.details: The waiting room screen: shows who's being called in each room, promotional videos and music.

steps.title: Open screen
steps.details: Opens the screen in another tab: take it to the TV (full screen with F11).

steps.title: Snooze
steps.details: Freezes the screen without turning it off.

steps.title: Turn off
steps.details: Changes what's shown in the waiting room as soon as you tap it.
